userMessage.content:
Apply one final focused CSS polish to the existing ÓRBITA revision. The corrected hero crop, four-line heading, icons and compact checkout structure now look good; preserve all of those. Preserve the catalog, options, commerce runtime and all page structure. Do not redesign the whole site. Browser review reveals that some CSS selectors target classes that the runtime does not actually emit: - Product catalog cards use `.menu-item__copy` containing a plain `h3` and `p`. The current design styles `.menu-item__name` and `.menu-item__desc`, which are absent in these cards. As a result, the featured parka's title is just ordinary 16px text. Style the real `.menu-item__copy h3` in the Oswald brand face with a clear 34–46px scale, appropriate line height and spacing; style the real paragraph below with restrained readable text. Map the real `.menu-item__copy` coherently into the grid so the featured image, product text, price and full-width “Elegir opciones” button create one polished composition. Keep the intentionally large first featured product and two-column remaining layout, with single-column mobile. Avoid unnamed auto grid placements that strand the price or controls far below the copy. - The real checkout heading is a plain `h1` under `[data-pagosya-checkout-page] .checkout-page__inner > div`; it has no `.checkout-page__title` class. It currently displays at 16px like paragraph text. Give this actual heading Oswald at a compact 42–56px desktop / 34–40px mobile, with a clear margin before the intro. Keep keyboard focus accessible without putting a permanent black rectangular border around the full heading. - Checkout line items are `.order-item` with first child `
product name and selected optionsformatted price
` followed by `
` with minus/output/plus. The price currently wraps mid-number into “Bs 1.08” and “5,00”. Ensure the price has enough room and stays on one line with no shrink; let the name wrap naturally. Put the quantity controls in their own clear row if necessary, using 44px buttons with visible borders. Apply to the real checkout and cart drawer elements. The selected example is Parka Cráter 01 · Hueso / M / Amplio / Kit completo at Bs 1.085,00. Only adjust authored presentation CSS for the actual runtime markup. Do not edit commerce.js or remove any runtime hooks. Preserve working add-to-cart, stock checks, option selection and checkout navigation. Keep all fixes within 390px mobile width.

answers.context:
ÓRBITA mantiene su identidad de manual editorial de expedición marciana: hueso #F0EEE6, tinta #191B19, bermellón #EF451F, Oswald condensada, códigos monoespaciados, reglas técnicas, motivos orbitales y fotografías reales. Conservar la revisión existente, su hero corregido con excursionista visible a la derecha, titular de cuatro líneas, iconos funcionales y checkout compacto. Mantener los cuatro productos existentes y sus 312 combinaciones, IDs, precios y stock; no duplicar ni modificar catálogo. Preservar selectores nativos agrupados, carrito lateral, checkout, rutas y controles data-cart-open visibles en cada ruta. Fotografías existentes: campaña marciana en hero; Parka hueso, Mochila bermellón, Botella grafito y Kit con estuche/parches. Prueba crítica: Parka Cráter 01 / Hueso / M / Amplio / Kit completo cuesta Bs 1.085,00 y debe conservarse como esa variante exacta en carrito y checkout. Footer: “Colección conceptual · Tienda de demostración”. Solicitud actual: pulido CSS localizado para el marcado real de tarjetas `.menu-item__copy`, encabezado real del checkout y elementos `.order-item`, también dentro del drawer; sin cambios estructurales ni de comercio.
Las imágenes ya presentes en la revisión aprobada conservan su uso y ubicación. Este pedido no autoriza reclasificarlas como referencia, retirarlas ni sustituirlas por dibujos. El resumen histórico y la interpretación automática no amplían el pedido actual.
